versions.subject: rule: base64 encoded value in command line
fix: possible FP with Veeam software
versions.detection:
selection:
   - CommandLine|endswith: '=='
   - CommandLine|contains: '== -'
filter:
   Image|endswith: '\VeeamAgent.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter*
